name: Coffee Brown
bio: Funk on the stereo, flares on the floor, and a sidearm that never misses a beat.
notes: Drive batch of 2026-11-01 evening, second drop ("stylized vintage pro", rigged): the owner's own model (owned). A rigged Meshy download ("All Animations": Mixamo joint names, read as Meshy's; its finger joints and two clips are not used: the hands are fitted by hands.mjs). Its extra shin joints ride the calves. Name from the owner.
